headline: Get Fenmane
title: How to Get Fenmane in Aniimo | Evolve Fentuft at Level 42 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want Fenmane in Aniimo? Catch a Fentuft in Driftwise Meadow, in the Breezy Plains region. Raise it to level forty two. Then you must complete one Aniimo exchange with a friend, a one time unlock that any trade counts for. Finally, spend one Roar Stone and evolve it from Aniimo Management. If the button is grey, a requirement is missing. Have you evolved your Fentuft yet? Comment below!
description: Fenmane evolves from Fentuft at level 42 after one Aniimo exchange with a friend and one Roar Stone; Fentuft is found in Driftwise Meadow, Breezy Plains.
